result.requirement: The system shall enable a Customer to submit a Feedback Record containing a satisfaction rating and textual comments after a Delivery Proof has been verified for a completed Order Request.
result.business_need: The business needs this capability to collect qualitative data on product quality and service performance to drive operational improvements and evaluate partner effectiveness.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Customer to view their completed Order Request history and select a specific delivery to provide feedback.
The system shall capture a satisfaction rating and free-text comments regarding product quality, packaging, delivery speed, and agent behavior.
The system shall associate the submitted Feedback Record with the corresponding Delivery Proof to ensure the review applies to a verified handover.
The system shall prevent the submission of feedback if the associated Delivery Proof has not been recorded or if the order is in a dispute state.
The system shall store the Feedback Record as a permanent artifact for the Platform Operator to analyze service quality metrics.
related_information_requirements: Qualitative ratings and comments regarding product quality, packaging, delivery speed, and agent behavior
Verified details about the ordering individual including unique identifiers and delivery addresses
Evidence that physical goods have reached the customer such as a digital signature or timestamped photo
business_rules: A Feedback Record can only be created after a Delivery Proof exists for the associated Order Request.
The system must link the Feedback Record to the specific Delivery Proof to validate the context of the review.
Feedback submissions must include both a numerical rating and optional textual comments to be considered valid.
The system shall not allow duplicate feedback submissions for the same Order Request by the same Customer.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer has completed an order and the Delivery Proof is verified in the system
acceptance_criteria.when: The Customer navigates to the order details and selects 'Submit Feedback'
acceptance_criteria.then: The system displays a form allowing the Customer to enter a rating and comments, which are saved as a Feedback Record upon submission

acceptance_criteria.given: A Customer attempts to submit feedback for an Order Request where the Delivery Proof is missing or invalid
acceptance_criteria.when: The Customer clicks the 'Submit Feedback' button
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the submission and displays an error message stating that delivery verification is required first
